answer: Every newcomer begins on a small knoll where their first work is visible to the whole neighbourhood. Each honest contribution sends a ripple outward: independent peers who witness it add their own attestation, and the ripple only keeps spreading while fresh witnesses keep confirming it. A sybil farm's ripples fold back onto the same knoll because the witnesses are the same few sockpuppets. Once enough distinct ripples have been verified, they rise as a plume of earned trust that lifts the agent into the open economy; fabricated ripples never lift anything.
